# streamline_consumer_group (Data Source)

Retrieves a Streamline consumer group that already exists. Consumer groups are created by applications when consumers connect; Terraform does not create them.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Consumer group identifier.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Number) Number of active group members.
- `state` (String) Current broker-reported group state.
